deals.evidence: MLB has approved David Blitzer's purchase of a 25 percent stake in the Guardians, with the option of becoming majority owner in six years.
deals.headline: MLB approves David Blitzer's 25% stake in the Guardians
deals.summary: MLB approved Blitzer's purchase of a 25% stake with an option to become majority owner in six years. Blitzer is co-founder of Harris Blitzer Sports & Entertainment and a Blackstone executive; the stake is held personally.

deals.evidence: The deal includes $435 million for these upgrades, which will come from the state, city, county and team.
deals.headline: Progressive Field lease extended to 2036 with $435m for upgrades
deals.investor: City of Cleveland, Cuyahoga County, State of Ohio and the club
deals.summary: Lease extended by at least 15 years to 2036 with options for 10 more; the deal includes $435 million for upgrades from the state, city, county and team.

notes: Revenue, operating income and player expenses are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season (net of revenue sharing and stadium debt service). Forbes lists owners 'David Blitzer, Paul Dolan' and 'Price Paid $323M' (Dolan family's purchase); Dolan family stake percentage not stated on a citable page. The Athletic (25 Mar 2026) reported on a succession plan for Blitzer to take majority control but is paywalled and was not read, so no control change is recorded.
